nc40896f5ff.headline: When it becomes possible to travel abroad again, will there be more pressure on the Central Bank's reserves?
nc40896f5ff.summary: Economists warn that resuming international flights in Argentina could increase pressure on the Central Bank's foreign currency reserves, though less than in 2019 due to currency devaluation and lower real incomes.
nc40896f5ff.why: Foreign currency reserves are critical for Argentina's economic stability and currency management; increased demand for foreign exchange from travel could strain reserves.

nb53cd905e0.summary: Ukraine will increase its minimum wage by 20% starting January 1, 2021.
nb53cd905e0.why: Minimum wage changes affect consumer spending, inflation, and labor market dynamics in Ukraine's economy.
